ev.q: Settlement construction is fully three-dimensional represented as voxels
Players are required to construct and manage a settlement
Survival mechanics require players to manage food production, storage, and seasonal changes
Set in an alternate history 14th century Britain
Players assign tasks and priorities rather than directly controlling characters
Players may customise their initial settlers by selecting their appearance, background traits, skills, and perks
Settlers possess individual moods and personalities that must be managed
